response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong web, backend, and testing craftsmanship, but the profile does not align with the core requirements of this role. The position demands 8 years of C++ programming and 5 years building large-scale infrastructure or compute/hardware-adjacent systems; the resume shows roughly 6 months of professional C/C++ work (National Instruments, 2014-2015) plus a university thesis project, with the remainder of the career in TypeScript/Node.js, D, and full-stack web development. The high-throughput microservices work at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby is the closest match but was in D and does not represent cloud compute platform architecture. There is also no formal technical leadership role, though mentoring via workshops, courses, and open-source project ownership is evident. Community teaching and open-source maintenance are genuine positives, but they do not offset the fundamental gap against the minimum qualifications.
strengths: Broad 15+ year engineering track record across web, mobile, embedded, and low-latency microservices handling millions of requests/second
Strong software craftsmanship focus: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, and authored testing tooling (Trial, Fluent-Asserts)
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing through conference talks, multi-day courses, and founding/leading an open-source platform
concerns: C++ experience far below the 8-year minimum — approximately 6 months professionally
No evidence of large-scale cloud compute platform, distributed systems architecture, or hardware/storage architecture ownership
No formal technical leadership title or documented experience managing cross-team priorities, deadlines, and deliverables

key_factors.factor: Mentoring, testing rigor, and open-source project ownership
